root_cause.summary: The adopted RNG/topology contract requires a frozen-formula-equivalent side-branch path and a mandatory nonzero-gradient side-branch case, but the frozen formula unconditionally zeroes the gradient before the branch norm is computed.
root_cause.frozen_dataflow: read parent gx/gy/gz -> unconditional if(true) sets all to 0.0 -> side-branch gn=sqrt(0)=0.0
root_cause.contract_formula_requirement: O06 gradient and geometry formulas byte-for-byte equivalent to frozen setNewSegment; only RNG and child identity may change.
root_cause.contract_draw_requirement: Sign draw ordinal 0 is absent when gn!=0.0.
root_cause.contract_qualification_requirement: Both side branch with gn==0 and side branch with gn!=0 are mandatory forced cases across P0-P5.
root_cause.why_writer_cannot_choose: Removing the gn!=0 case changes adopted test semantics; making gn!=0 reachable changes growth/topology behavior prohibited by the adoption boundary.

required_resolution.recommended: Issue a new contract/KAT revision preserving frozen behavior, remove the unreachable gn!=0 side-branch forced case, and bind sign draw ordinal 0 as always present for accepted side branches.
required_resolution.alternative: Explicitly authorize and exactly bind nonzero-gradient side-branch behavior as a growth/topology change, then obtain independent review.
required_resolution.prohibited: Do not use a synthetic-only gn!=0 helper, inject a post-zeroing gradient, or silently choose precedence between normative clauses.
